correctness.rationale: For d>=3 the individual curvature-weighted random-inscribed-polytope leading errors have functionals I_j(rho)=integral kappa^(1/(d-1)) H_(d-j) rho^(-2/(d-1)) dS. Holder with beta=(d-1)/(d+1) gives individual M_j and density G^beta/int G^beta for every simplex mixture G=sum lambda_j w_j/M_j. Concavity and directional KKT at simplex maximum prove exact global inf-density/max-objective=minimax=max-simplex F and uniqueness of common optimal density. Q=1 forces coincident endpoint densities kappa^[d/(d+1)] and kappa^[1/(d+1)], hence constant Gauss curvature and a sphere. Uniform second-order expansion of individually normalized v_j cancels all unknown individual second-order terms; first-order curvature coefficients r_j=(d-j+1)/(d-1), endpoint range one, and Popoviciu give max variance 1/4. Coefficient Var(h)/(4(d+1)), equal endpoint mixture for nonconstant h, density correction (h-mean)/2. For spheroid Gauss derivative (d+1)u1^2-2, fourth moments produce (d^2-1)/[2d^2(d+2)]. All asymptotics concern leading N^(-2/(d-1)) errors; no finite-N minimax interchange. Original exact rational checks independently reproduced d=3,4,6,9 spherical coefficients.
residual_risks: Smooth local law needs uniform C3 support/normal Taylor regularity, nonconstant first Gauss variation for unique endpoint mixing. The O(t^3) ellipsoid remainder follows uniform analytic Taylor, not a claim of analytic optimizer weights.
